caption: The drawing features two distinct wooden objects set against a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a long, vertical wooden panel that is rectangular in shape with slightly rounded corners at the top. This panel is decorated with intricate carvings, including floral and geometric patterns running down its length, and it has two circular holes near the bottom edge. The wood is depicted in shades of brown with hints of green and reddish tones, and the carved grooves create darker shadows for added depth. On the right side, there is a square wooden block with beveled edges, featuring a central circular hole resembling a keyhole. The square block projects to the right, casting a detailed shadow that indicates a directional light source from the left. The rendering of both objects highlights the texture of the wood and the precise craftsmanship of the carvings. Both objects are spaced evenly apart, occupying the middle section of the drawing without overlapping.
title: Candle Mold
